rules.name: Unexpected Process Execution from Web Directory
rules.description: Behavioral detection rules for unknown zero-day exploitation patterns
rules.query: SELECT "siem_zero_day_zero_day_087", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%unexpected%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%process%') AND "value" > 0
